package.name: custom_ur_human_tracking
package.description: Human arm tracking (perception) node. Uses MediaPipe Pose + an AprilTag (ArUco) marker as an intermediate origin to track a person's shoulder/elbow/ wrist, auto-calibrates limb lengths from a held T-Pose, and republishes the forearm into the Gazebo "world" frame as a PoseArray (/human_skeleton) plus RViz MarkerArray (/ghost_arm_visual). A companion node (human_obstacle_bridge) turns the tracked forearm into a chain of SPHERE collision objects on /planning_scene so the AAPF supervisor (custom_ur_aapf_2) avoids the person.
